title: Semantics at an Angle: When Cosine Similarity Works Until It Doesn't
abstract: arXiv:2504.16318v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Cosine similarity is a standard comparison rule for learned representations in information retrieval, natural language processing, computer vision, and multimodal learning. Its popularity is well founded: it removes positive radial scale, is computationally convenient, and often matches objectives that train normalized embeddings. These same properties also delimit what cosine can express. Normalization discards radial variation; anisotropic representations can compress angular contrast; high-dimensional neighborhoods can develop hubs; and a symmetric, uncalibrated score may be mismatched to the relation of interest. This article offers a selective review organized around a simple principle: the usefulness of cosine similarity depends jointly on the learned representation, any normalization or post-processing, the scoring rule, and the downstream decision. translated_title: 角度中的语义：余弦相似度何时有效，何时失效
translated_abstract: 余弦相似度是信息检索、自然语言处理、计算机视觉和多模态学习中学到的表示进行对比的标准规则。它的流行是有充分依据的：它消除了正的径向尺度，计算方便，并且常常与训练归一化嵌入的目标相匹配。然而，这些相同的特性也限定了余弦所能表达的内容。归一化会丢弃径向变化；各向异性的表示可能压缩角度上的对比；高维邻域中可能出现枢纽现象；而对称的、未经校准的分数可能与所关心的关系不匹配。本文提供了一篇有选择性的综述，围绕一个简单的原则展开：余弦相似度的有用性共同取决于所学到的表示、任何归一化或后处理、评分规则以及下游决策。我们推导了主要的几何恒等式，并区分了导致失效的各种机制……
tldr: 本文系统综述了余弦相似度的适用条件与失效机制，指出其有效性并非普适，而是由所学表示、归一化与后处理、评分规则和下游决策共同决定的。
en_tdlr: This paper offers a selective review showing that the usefulness of cosine similarity is not universal but depends jointly on the learned representation, normalization and post-processing, the scoring rule, and the downstream decision.
